notes.title: The Retirement of JFR
notes.content:
Firstly, I wanted to thank anyone who has played the game over the years. This silly little game I made in my 2nd year of university got so many more downloads than I ever expected. I released it much earlier than I should have and I often look back on this game much like I did with the original Jay Fighter, my first foray into programming. But unlike that game, I won't be trying to erase this piece of my past and pretending it never happened. This was my first ever Steam game, and it is only fitting that it stay up for download.

I have disabled the multiplayer feature as it used a now unsupported networking feature in the game engine. There also won't be anymore expected updates to this game. Maybe one day, I will revist it and fix some things. But more realistically, I would probably want to remake the game entirely. Whatever happens, I hope you enjoyed JFR! What little of it that I released.

- Taliyah Pottruff

notes.title: Bugs
notes.content: It has come to our attention that there are quite a few bugs that slipped through testing. Rest assured, we hear you! We want to make [b]Jay Fighter: Remastered[/b] the best experience it can be and you can contribute to that. If you want, can report a bug in the current version of the game using this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeaY3jzo_FV1_tdWh6HP4lp6ojulgZkKWf0R7WL0oLdIw5_cw/viewform?usp=sf_link]form[/url]. We're working on getting a patch out soon.

notes.title: Jay Fighter: Remastered Released
notes.content: It may be a day behind what we originally planned, but we are glad we can finally release this game for you to enjoy and play! We originally wanted to release the game on November 30 to coincide with the 5 year anniversary of the original game created by our founder Trenton Pottruff. However, the game was released at midnight of Nov 30/Dec 1, so it technically was December 1, and therefore we still released it on the same day 5 years later. What? We're not trying to make this work on anything... ːhappy_creepː
